name: ikechukwukalu/magicmake
description: A scaffolding package for an opinionated Laravel coding style.

suggest.calebporzio/sushi: Required by generated in-memory Eloquent model integrations.
suggest.ikechukwukalu/clamavfileupload: Required by generated file-upload and email-data integrations.
suggest.knuckleswtf/scribe: Required when generated applications publish API documentation.
suggest.kreait/laravel-firebase: Required by generated Firebase notification integrations.
suggest.laragear/two-factor: Required by generated two-factor authentication artifacts.
suggest.laravel/socialite: Required by generated social authentication artifacts.
suggest.laravel/ui: Required when using the documented Bootstrap UI setup.
suggest.mobiledetect/mobiledetectlib: Required by generated mobile-device detection integrations.
suggest.predis/predis: Required when generated applications use the Predis client.
suggest.pusher/pusher-php-server: Required when generated applications use Pusher broadcasting.
suggest.react/http: Required by generated asynchronous HTTP integrations.
suggest.sentry/sentry-laravel: Required when generated applications use Sentry reporting.
suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Required by generated roles and permissions artifacts.
